name: zeropdf-pdf-mcp
description: Generate and manipulate PDFs locally with the zero-dependency zeropdf-pdf engine.
long_description: Generate PDFs from a declarative template spec and parse, merge, split, extract, append, and validate existing PDFs — all on your machine. Files are read and written under a workspace directory you choose at install time; the server refuses paths outside it and never overwrites a file unless told to.

workspaceDir.title: Workspace directory
workspaceDir.description: Folder the server may read and write PDFs in. Paths outside it are rejected.

tools.name: generate_pdf
tools.description: Render a PDF from a declarative JSON document (text, tables, images, fonts, headers).

tools.name: extract_text
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF, per page.

tools.name: get_pdf_info
tools.description: Read PDF metadata and page count.

tools.name: inspect_pdf
tools.description: Read forms, bookmarks, attachments, and accessibility flags.

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into one file per page.

tools.name: extract_pages
tools.description: Extract a subset of pages into a new PDF.

tools.name: append_pages
tools.description: Append pages from one PDF onto another.

tools.name: validate_pdf2
tools.description: Check a PDF for PDF 2.0 conformance issues.
